spec.name: hb-mother-ashka-drank-first-and
spec.title: The Hollow Brood: Mother Ashka drank first, and drank the most. Sh
spec.speaker: speaker.nurse-ardi

request.text: [sorrowful] [trembling] Mother Ashka drank first, and drank the most. She does not know us now.

text: Mother Ashka drank first, and drank the most. She does not know us now.

voice.description: A middle-aged nurse of a ruined colony, about fifty: a soft, gentle alto voice, kind and motherly, exhausted, frightened and grieving, trembling slightly, speaking quietly as if still afraid to be heard. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
